_comment: Sponsor booths for the walk-around world.
This file is CONFIG, not code: adding, removing or repainting a booth
needs no rebuild of anything but the asset bundle. x/y are world units,
and the sponsor row is the east arm of the cross: x 1000-1600, y 400-800.
Names below are placeholders until the real list is confirmed.

sponsors.name: Sponsor A
sponsors.blurb: Placeholder booth. Swap this entry for a real sponsor: only this file changes.

sponsors.name: Sponsor B
sponsors.blurb: Placeholder booth. Every booth is painted in the brand colour named here.

sponsors.name: Sponsor C
sponsors.blurb: Placeholder booth. Walk up to a booth and its panel opens; walk away and it closes.

sponsors.name: Sponsor D
sponsors.blurb: Placeholder booth. Booth positions are world coordinates, so a booth can be moved without touching code.
